anim3.notes: This describes the original arrangement. Re-map all seconds through the same scene clock as the animation before using the current 48 kHz audio pipeline. The original file has no explicit ENV or DARK list.

sceneSfx.method: S() cue array evaluated in browser
sceneSfx.retime: map each SFX.t and duration endpoints with the selected scene instance's knots
sceneSfx.synthesis: scripts/audiolib.py supports the original SFX type names

externalTrack.condition: This offset only suits the original music; re-detect the downbeat in each new supplied track
externalTrack.musicBlend: replaces synth bed; keeps atonal risers/sub drops; original code normalizes supplied track to 0.9 peak

anim4.sfxSource: audio.py GEN mapping; 31 types actually used
anim4.retime: Use manifest scene knots piecewise for every music event, gain-envelope key, dark-band boundary and SFX cue. Regenerate music for target length; do not stretch 108.4s original WAV.

dependencies.synth: numpy plus audio.py waveform functions; no external music required
dependencies.externalMusic: new licensed source track from user; do not reuse original track automatically
dependencies.voice: new talk audio, aligned separately at 48 kHz mix/export

audio.displaySuggestion: 每种SFX提供播放按钮和波形；配乐显示章节、能量包络、重拍和上升段，可合成后试听
